}}'''Ranun Sinah''' was a member of the [[Children of the Light]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ranun Sinah}}

== Appearance ==
He was young.

== Activities ==
He was killed in battle against a [[Shadowspawn]] army when the Children were attacked in [[Ghealdan]].

==Trivia==
Ranun Sinah is named for Jaswant Singh Ranu, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
